_comment: Human-readable restatement of what is frozen for dev-c7 (PREREGISTRATION.md). NOT the runner's manifest.json, which is compared with this file after each run; any frozen value that differs is reported as a deviation. Hash formats: case_order_sha256 = sha256('\n'.join(ids)) with no trailing newline; case_sha256_table_sha256 = sha256(json.dumps({id: sha}, sort_keys=True)); prompt.assembled_sha256 is over the text sent (one trailing newline removed), prompt.file_sha256 over the file bytes; expected_config_hash = sha256(json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)) rebuilt offline from the registered command. Null fields are filled after the run.
frozen_code_commit: the Amendment 1 commit (it adds PREREGISTRATION.md section 11; its sha is reported in the PR); was f73ec91a

options.started_aborted_scoring: not scored; listed unscored (started-aborted/<case>.json). Each gate keeps score.py's own denominator; G7 uses planned cases. Recorded, started-aborted and never-started counts are reported next to every gate.
options.spend_limit: uncapped (--no-spend-limit on all three commands; config.spend_limit)

subsets: (b) neither a reported-count nor the estimate flag
context_policy.sizing: context-sizing.json: max estimate 15970 incl. the 640 reserve at 8192 (0 of 383 at or over 16384), 14833 at 4096; 0 of 73 first messages paginated at 8192, 28 at 4096
context_policy.repair_turns: the sizing has no repair turn; a repair adds the invalid reply (up to 640 tokens, num_predict) and a repair message; the reported-count flags (prompt_reaches_input_budget, reported_prompt_did_not_grow) catch any truncation that results

gpu_safety.offline: gpu-fit-offline.json: expected to fit fully (assumed qwen35 layout 20142 MiB of 24124 MiB free; conservative bound 23214 MiB); an estimate, never an authorisation
gpu_safety.runtime_check: full-gpu-v2 (Amendment 1; was full-gpu-v1): one /api/ps read after the warm-up AND after every case call that reports a reload (load_duration above 1 s, or none reported); full GPU = only this model resident, size_vram == size, context_length (if reported) >= 16384; at the warm-up anything else unloads and skips (exit 3, gpu_fit_skip (full-gpu-v2), no case call); at a reload it aborts (exit 3, gpu_fit_abort; the case started-aborted, unscored), unloads, no retry. Amendment 2: a reload is detected only after the call that reloaded, so that one call (at most 120 s) may have run partly on the CPU; the run aborts at the first detected split, at most one call per run can be affected, and an eviction in the middle of a call cannot be prevented
gpu_safety.declare_activity: dev-c7 qwen pass, scope ai,ollama-prime, ttl 60m

retry_repair.model_call_failure: recorded with its receipt, forced escalate, no retry, the run continues
retry_repair.preflight_failure_before_first_case: Haiku or Astra: one more start with the same command under run id <id>-r2, both reported; qwen: busy, digest mismatch or GPU-fit skip skips, load failure aborts, never repeated

haiku.cost_recorded: per call total_cost_usd as reported by the CLI (an estimate) and the reported tokens

astra.cost_recorded: per call tokens from the event stream; Codex reports no cost: an estimate only from a cited published price, else not estimated

tables: run (with the qwen GPU-fit outcome at the warm-up and at every detected reload, and the first measured response)
gates guarded (C7 vs dev-c6 vs dev-c5; Astra vs dev-c6)
context and failures (subsets a and b)
uncalled available checks at the decision prefix (unchanged counter)
benchmark-passability report (Astra, passability-3) with the dev-c6 transition
passability: scripts/passability_v3.py (policy passability-3, Amendment 1, supersedes passability-2): passability-1 with six changes for v3.1-format: (1) v3.1 case-evidence resolution; (2) v3.1 audit typing for the checker; (3) tools-v3 candidates (an epub_inspect candidate is already shown only when the case evidence carries the same body view), v3.1 links, v3.1-session page cost at wire_bytes; (4) fidelity over the v3.1 renderer AND every deciding observation's kinds (statement kinds, provenance) and report (method metadata): missing or changed = presentation problem, on an unfetched page = not obtained; (5) free-text identity unknown once body evidence is among the observations; (6) a row of an identity-sensitive label whose case shows or serves body evidence, computed as model error, not obtained, presentation problem, obtainable not obtained or evidence gap, is undetermined (hand judgement), computed category kept. Body evidence: delivered nonempty text, or positively evidenced excerpt availability (an indexed non-navigation item with characters > 0); key presence alone never counts. Categories, constants and rows otherwise unchanged
confounds: format v3.1-format and tools v3 vs v3 / v2
amendment_1: Pre-measurement review of 5f71b6d3 (Opus: P2, P3; Astra AUDIT-ASTRA-32: items 1 to 3), before any model call: full-gpu-v2 (re-check at every reload, abort if not 100% GPU); passability-3 (fidelity covers kinds, provenance and report metadata; body-identity dependence is undetermined; body evidence never inferred from key presence and never suppressing a materially different inspection); the repair-turn statement. Changed: frozen_src_tree_sha1, runs.qwen.argv / expected_config_hash, gpu_safety.runtime_check, passability, analysis_scripts.
amendment_2: Re-check of 1419f4b7 (Opus P3 x2; Astra AUDIT-ASTRA-33 cleared), text only: the full-gpu-v2 guarantee stated exactly (one reloading call may have run partly on the CPU; abort at the first detected split; that case unscored; at most one call per run; mid-call eviction not preventable) and gpu_fit_skip (full-gpu-v2) named. No code, prompt, hash or config hash change.
